submission.justification: K2 has the best resolution (2.9%) but its assayed background of 2.0 counts/kg/day is 4x over the hard 0.5 limit, so it is excluded. Of the remaining crystals, K1 (0.3 counts/kg/day, 4.5% FWHM) has better resolution than K3 (0.1 counts/kg/day, 8.5% FWHM). 5 cm is the thickness the 2025 simulation used. That simulation found weak thickness dependence in the 3-8 cm range, so I did not re-simulate other thicknesses.

requirements.requirement: Crystal is one of the three candidates

requirements.evidence: The K1 assay gave 0.3 counts/kg/day. K2 gave 2.0 and fails. K3 gave 0.1.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: K1 gives 4.5% FWHM at 5 cm, the best among crystals within the background budget. The figure comes from the 2025 simulation, not a new run. The unconstrained best, K2 at 2.9%, is excluded by the background limit.
